verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS AI video platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. The docs describe only a proprietary hosted API, CLI, MCP server and paid plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
